name: Accio Bridge
author: xenstar
description: Accio Bridge / Accio 桥接: use Codex++ models in stock Accio Work for chat, agents and image generation while keeping your account, history, skills and UI.

hint.en: Start Accio from Codex++ so its existing account and features use Codex++ models.
hint.zh: 从 Codex++ 启动 Accio，保留现有账号和功能并使用 Codex++ 模型。

description.en: Optional absolute path. Leave empty to use the standard per-user install.
description.zh: 可选绝对路径。留空时使用当前用户的默认安装位置。

description.en: auto tries the Codex++ image gateway first and falls back to the Codex subscription bridge. codexplus keeps the Codex++ gateway only.
description.zh: auto 优先走 Codex++ 生图网关，失败时回退到 Codex 订阅桥接；codexplus 只走 Codex++ 网关。

label.zh: 仅用 Codex++ 生图网关
仅用 Codex 订阅桥接

title.zh: Accio 内的生图模型列表

description.en: group shows a separate Codex++ Image section so you can pick GPT Image or a Qwen/Wan image model. hidden keeps them routable but out of the picker.
description.zh: group 会单独显示「Codex++ 生图」分组，可选择 GPT Image 或 Qwen/Wan 生图模型；hidden 保留可路由但不显示在选择列表。

label.zh: 可路由但不在列表显示

description.en: Used when Accio asks for an image without a model of its own, for example qwentokenplan/wan2.7-image-pro. auto lets Codex++ choose.
description.zh: 当 Accio 发起生图但未指定模型时使用，例如 qwentokenplan/wan2.7-image-pro；auto 表示交给 Codex++ 自行选择。
